create_litre_translator: create a LitreTranslator instance to execute embedded Python code from docutils document nodes
visit_raw_litre_nodes: visit raw docutils nodes with format litre to extract and execute embedded Python code
visit_comment_at_directives: visit comment nodes starting with @ to execute embedded Python code in reStructuredText
override_execute_context: override the _execute method to set up local variable context before invoking embedded code
use_litre_writer: use the Writer class to translate a docutils document and execute all embedded Python code
